content.text: A single webhook subscription configured with two endpoint URLs receives each event twice on both endpoints (four HTTP deliveries total) instead of once per endpoint. Fan-out should produce N deliveries for N endpoints, not N×N.

The dispatcher iterates endpoints and, for each, reloads the full endpoint list from the subscription snapshot before enqueue. Nested iteration multiplies the set: with 2 endpoints the inner loop runs twice per outer step.
Discovered via partner logs showing duplicate delivery_id pairs differing only by a trailing endpoint index that was applied twice. No data loss on our side, but partner automations double-executed.
